Package eu.algites.lib.common.documentation.model

Interface AIiDocumentationBlockElement

All Superinterfaces:
AIiDocumentationElement
All Known Subinterfaces:
AIiDocumentationBlockElementWriteAccess, AIiDocumentationCodeBlock, AIiDocumentationCodeBlockWriteAccess, AIiDocumentationContainerElement, AIiDocumentationContainerElementWriteAccess, AIiDocumentationDocument, AIiDocumentationDocumentWriteAccess, AIiDocumentationParagraph, AIiDocumentationParagraphWriteAccess, AIiDocumentationSection, AIiDocumentationSectionWriteAccess, AIiDocumentationTable, AIiDocumentationTableWriteAccess
public interface AIiDocumentationBlockElement extends AIiDocumentationElement
Represents a block-level documentation element.

Block elements form the structural body of a document. They may be rendered as standalone output units such as sections, paragraphs, tables, or code blocks. Inline elements such as links and references are not block elements and should normally appear inside paragraph-like elements.
